shortDescription: Create a secret in Delineas Secret Server

options.name: random_password_alphabet
options.description: String containing all allowed characters for random password generation

options.name: random_password_digit_requirement
options.description: Minimum number of digit characters the random password will contain

options.name: random_password_length
options.description: Number of characters the random password will contains

options.name: random_password_lowercase_requirement
options.description: Minimum number of lowercase characters the random password will contain

options.name: random_password_special_requirement
options.description: Minimum number of special characters the random password will contain

options.name: random_password_uppercase_requirement
options.description: Minimum number of uppercase characters the random password will contain

options.name: sdk_config_directory
options.description: Directory where the SDK .config files are located (mutually exclusive with username/password authentication)

options.name: secret_folder
options.description: The name of the folder the secret will be placed in

options.name: secret_items
options.description: Additional parameters for the chosen secret template

options.name: secret_name
options.description: The display name of the secret

options.name: secret_overwrite
options.description: Flag to enable overwriting of an existing secret. If true, everytime this module runs the secret password will be changed to the specified password or a new random password if use_random_password is true.

options.name: secret_server_host
options.description: The hostname of your Secret Server instance

options.name: secret_server_password
options.description: The password of the user that will be used to contact the Secret Server API (mutually exclusive with SDK authentication)

options.name: secret_server_username
options.description: The username of the user that will be used to contact the Secret Server API (mutually exclusive with SDK authentication)

options.name: secret_server_username_domain
options.description: The domain pertaining to your username. This is prepend to your username (mutually exclusive with SDK authentication)

options.name: secret_template
options.description: The type of secret you want to create

options.name: sha512_encrypt_password
options.description: Output for password parameter will be sha512 encrypted for security purposes

options.name: use_random_password
options.description: When true will generate a random password with requirements for secret_items.Password

options.name: use_sdk
options.description: If the module should use the SDK to authenticate with Secret Server (mutually exclusive with username/password authentication)
